Each item has the code context (±3 lines), the cited RFC and its title, and the RFC(s) that replace it per the RFC Editor index. Label each item independently, from its context only, with one `label`: - `update`: the text cites the old RFC as the specification the code or docs follow or define behaviour by; a reader would be better served by the replacement.
